title: Initiative Authority Temporary Hold Envelope
purpose: Represent a conservative hold created by unresolved learner-authored authority conflicts without turning the hold into a hidden precedence rule.
rules: A temporary hold must point to the conflict and learner-authored rules that caused it.
An active hold may reduce initiative but may not create precedence or a new learner rule.
A hold is conflict-local: it is not a person-wide preference and cannot become a reusable default.
A hold ends or is recomputed when a source rule changes, the scope ends, or the learner explicitly resolves the conflict.
A hold does not silently carry across sessions.
The hold remains reversible and explainable through canonical pointers without copying raw private dialogue.
Replacing a hold with a winning rule requires explicit learner resolution; system expiry may only remove the hold and trigger recomputation.
